note.en: Semi-analytic reference Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas. Dimensionless; masses 1/2/3 and kBT=1. Fixed linear constraints Cq=0 and CM⁻¹p=0; redundant rows are compared on the same tangent space.
